<?php
$x="old";$y="new";$n=0;
function ping(){echo "P;";}
function old_value(){echo "V;";return "old";}
function &f():string{global $x,$y,$n;try{return old_value()."";}finally{echo "O;";ping();try{try{return $y;}finally{++$n;echo "I",$n,";";if($n===1){$y=new stdClass;}else{ping();$y="fixed";}}}catch(TypeError $e){echo "C;";}echo "A;";}}
try{$r=&f();echo "r=",$r,";";$r="changed";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R;";}
echo "x=",$x,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";
